_comment: ZeRO-2 BF16 + CPU optimizer offload for Gemma 4 31B target + E2B draft on 2x 80GB H200. ZeRO-2 replicates params (no partition), avoids ZeRO-3's wrong gather on tied frozen embed (mean_tau=0 root cause). Per-rank est: target 62G (untied 64.8G) + draft 9G + grads 4.6G + optim CPU 0G + acts 5G ≈ 82G — tight, gradient checkpointing required (set via deepspeed activation_checkpointing or HF model.gradient_checkpointing_enable).
